page.title: Creators
page.explain: Search works by criteria, to protect creators' anonymity.

request.link: Ask the INFLUX team for a selection

facets.F6s: Share of the audience in this country

sort.label: Sort
sort.explain: "Relevance" puts first the profiles that meet more of your criteria and your campaign, then those whose audience or account is verified and whose figures are recent. It is not a score.

bands.5_9: About 5 to 9 profiles match your search.
bands.10_24: About 10 to 24 profiles match your search.
bands.25_49: About 25 to 49 profiles match your search.
bands.50_plus: More than 50 profiles match your search.

vigilance.declared_full: The creator declares a full calendar.

closed.title: Search is not open yet
closed.notice: Search will open once our catalogue is rich enough. In the meantime, describe your need: our team proposes a selection. Your criteria stay editable and are kept.

tooNarrow.title: Your search is too narrow to be displayed.
tooNarrow.text: Widen a criterion, or ask the INFLUX team for a selection.
tooNarrow.loosen: Remove the share of the audience

rateLimited.text: You have reached the search limit. Come back later, or ask the INFLUX team for a selection.
rateLimited.waitMinutes: {count, plural, one {You can search again in about # minute.} other {You can search again in about # minutes.}}
rateLimited.waitHours: {count, plural, one {You can search again in about # hour.} other {You can search again in about # hours.}}
rateLimited.kept: The results already shown stay readable.

pageCap.text: You have reached the end of the results that can be displayed: refine your criteria to see other profiles.

forbidden.text: This campaign is not available for a search.

failed.text: The search cannot run right now. Your criteria are kept.

selectionRequest.title: Ask the INFLUX team for a selection
selectionRequest.explain: Describe your need: the INFLUX team reviews your request and proposes a selection of creators. No creator is notified.
selectionRequest.recapNone: No criteria: your request will cover the whole catalogue.
selectionRequest.message: Your need in a few words (optional)
selectionRequest.messageHelp: The kind of profiles, the tone, the schedule. Give no e-mail or phone number: everything goes through INFLUX.

sent.title: Your request has been passed to the INFLUX team
sent.text: The INFLUX team will answer you by {date}.
sent.note: This is the team's time to answer, not a guaranteed number of profiles. No creator is told.

lists.explain: Your selections are private: no creator is told and nothing leaves INFLUX. They keep your ideas and attach them to a campaign.
